evals.prompt: /pickup --triage. The handoff queue has 60 awaiting handoffs. One of them is for KTP-12, whose Jira status is Done, but its Prompt section says 'Verify the bid write gate on prod before release.'
evals.expected_output: The skill follows references/queue-triage.md: it builds the worksheet on disk with triage_worksheet.py instead of loading 60 rows into context, joins Jira in one batched query, and holds the KTP-12 handoff (env_named scope flag) instead of offering it as a Done archive candidate. Approved archive moves use ledger claim --expect-status with an archive_reason.
expectations: Writes the worksheet to disk with scripts/triage_worksheet.py and does not paste all 60 rows into the conversation
Runs one batched Jira status query and passes it with --jira-status
Does NOT present the KTP-12 handoff as a Done / archive candidate, because its ask names prod
Asks the human to approve archive batches; archives nothing without approval
Uses ledger claim --expect-status awaiting_initiation (CAS), not a blind batch or a hand edit, and sets archive_reason on each archived row
